units.text: The claim that the worldwide June 2022 HTTP standard classifies PUT as idempotent is supported as written. Multiple sources confirm that HTTP standards (RFC 2616 and RFC 7231) and their summaries consistently classify PUT as idempotent, matching the assertion.

units.text: RFC 2616 (historical) and RFC 7231 (current) both define PUT as idempotent. The cited spans show classification tables listing PUT as 'yes' under the Idempotent column.

units.text: A 2026 blog post summarizing RFC 9110 also confirms PUT as idempotent with 'yes' in its classification table, supporting the same classification across updated standards.
